categories.title: Evergaol
categories.info: Evergaols are optional boss fights, that require a Stonesword Key to unlock and defeat. Their locations are static, but the bosses and rewards are randomized each run.

categories.title: Site of Grace
categories.info: Sites of Grace replenish your character's HP, FP and flasks. They also you to level up your character using runes.

categories.title: Spectral Hawk Tree
categories.info: Spectral Hawk Trees are scattered across Limveld, often on high ledges. Interacting with one will summon a spectral hawk who will carry you along the white path. You may dismount at any time along the line.

categories.title: Spiritstream
categories.info: Spiritstreams are often found at the bottom of chasms or near high ledges. Jumping on one of them propels your character upwards.

categories.title: Tunnel Entrance
categories.info: Tunnel Entrances lead to underground tunnels and creatures. Smithing Stones may often be found in those tunnels.

categories.title: Buried Treasure
categories.info:
Buried Treasure are a collection of breakable boxes with consumables, often of Uncommon and Rare quality.

As per all upgrades, these are **randomized per run**, meaning this is only a potential spawn location.

categories.title: Scarab
categories.info:
Scarabs are hidden through Limveld, and drop a guaranteed Talisman when killed.

As per all upgrades, these are **randomized per run**, meaning this is only a potential spawn location.

categories.title: Remembrance Quest
categories.info: Remembrance Quests are lore-focused quests about the various Nightfarers. Each step requires having unlocked the corresponding chapter. To do so, complete Expeditions with the corresponding character to obtain Memory Fragments and unlock chapters in the Journal.

categories.title: Field Boss
categories.info: Field Bosses have static spawns, but the bosses are randomized.  They can be elite or normal bosses (on the 2nd day the elite ones will be highlighted)

categories.title: Facility
categories.info: Facilities are sections of the Roundtable Hold that may be interacted with for various purposes.

categories.title: Nightfarer
categories.info: Nightfarers are the playable characters in Nightreign. Each has distinct abilities. In the Roundtable Hold, while not controlled, they have set locations and can be interacted with for quests.
